evidence_scope: R45 frozen Train49/Val15 snippets vs 46 R50 prompt-only cases; nine private source-story IDs × five new source worlds
input_provenance: Byte-exact private uploaded R45 and R50 ZIP inputs used in a one-off read-only local audit; this Git record is aggregate only

method.vectorization: sklearn TfidfVectorizer(char 2–4 gram, sublinear_tf=True, max_features=200000), fit on 669 R45 messages + 46 new input + 46 world-card + 46 joined-rule texts
method.pair_comparison: Each R50 new user input compared to R45 messages grouped by original source_story_id; report max cosine per 9×5 world pair
method.r45_ordinals: 1–9 sorted source_story_id internally; source UUIDs and names deliberately omitted from Git
method.manual_ai_scope: Selected 18 distinctive names/aliases/organization/setting phrases from new world-card descriptions and checked against R45 non-System text; inspected representative R45 messages by nine source groups and all five R50 world-card summaries
method.owner_policy: AI-only R50 content review accepted; this is a scoped AI semantic screening, not a full corpus identity certificate

known_prior_world_graph_limitation.source: R45_SCOPED_WORLD_COMPONENT_REVIEW.json in private R45 frozen ZIP
known_prior_world_graph_limitation.implication: Exact UUID difference is insufficient evidence of transitive world independence

limitations: R45 comparison comprises 64 frozen train/validation rows, not complete original narratives and all historical aliases
Only representative R45 passages were semantically read; no full-by-world human-readable narrative proof
Character renaming, transliteration, paraphrased shared events, generic genre similarity and hidden cross-world relationship can evade anchor/TF-IDF screens
R50 50/50 timepoint card interval replay is a separate prior gate; this review does not certify every point-in-time card-field fact
Five source UUIDs do not imply five independently connected world components until graph closure
privacy: No original prompts, story text, character names, R45 source UUIDs, per-case provenance, HF secrets or answer keys in this Git report
